provenance: Written by Claude, approved by team and supervisor (stated by Amjd 2026-11-18)
task: Task 80 (2026-11-22): development cases for Saudi dialect, standard Arabic, English and mixed sentences. Used to tune the dialect layer and the fallback's per-variety thresholds. Never frozen; may be read and tuned on.
disclosure: Written and labelled by Claude on 2026-11-22, after reading the engine and lexicon as they were before Task 80 and before testset-dialect.json was written. Texts are made up: no real names, links or projects.
additions: Task 80b (2026-11-22, team decision): 18 hard negatives (dev-dl-hn-01 to 18, "addedIn": "Task 80b"): ordinary activities whose words sound like project work (testing a recipe, backing up photos, a phone lock code, planning an outing, asking family what to buy) and must suggest nothing; 8 Saudi dialect, 5 MSA, 5 English. Written by Claude without opening the lexicon, the example sentences or any test set. Added after the per-variety thresholds were tuned (eval/project-suggest/config.json hybridV2 records the 44-case file it was tuned on); for future tuning only, nothing was retuned on them.

varieties.dialect: Saudi or Gulf dialect in Arabic letters; English tech words written in Arabic letters count as dialect (أبلكيشن، داتابيس).
varieties.msa: Modern Standard Arabic in Arabic letters only.
varieties.mixed: An Arabic sentence (dialect or standard) with English words in Latin letters. lang is ar.

labellingRules.evidence: A capability is expected when the text says the student did the work. A wish or plan (أبغى أتعلم، ودي أشتغل، I want to learn), attending an event or course without doing the work, and other people's work are not evidence: should-abstain.
labellingRules.database: Designing a database, its tables, keys or relations, or writing queries. Operating it (backup, restore, permissions) is db-operations.
labellingRules.other capabilities: As named in their descriptions (eval/project-suggest/skill-descriptions.json). Building a system without programming detail is not software engineering on its own.
